people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
translations.bsb: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.
translations.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
translations.asv: So then they that are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
